verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.github.com that returns HTTP 200. They also confirm a Markdown rendition of the Projects docs page (.md suffix returns HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at agent-friendly docs that cover Projects. Missing for 10: a Projects-specific llms.txt or index (the file found is GitHub-wide), and first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering and how agents should consume it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
